result.boundary: Original Villa uses the same fresh Cook and configuration before/after. Native counters establish zero cold streamer allocation/updates and no Nanite bounds-change collection. After Nanite has actually been used, valid loaded asset pages remain cached while streaming sleeps. Per-scene activity changes invalidate old pending/completed occlusion queries once. Both atomic paths preserve first-frame disocclusion. GPU resource labels were unavailable in the old runtime and do not independently prove absence of GPU allocations. Ordinary occlusion and texture streaming still operate. Movement measurements are viewport submission intervals on this machine; they do not establish full Nanite-on performance acceptance.
